zap_pte_range has been counting the pages it frees in tlb->freed
tlb_finish_mmu has used that to update the mm's rss.  That got stranger when I
added anon_rss
column2: yet updated it by a different route; and stranger when rss and

column1: anon_rss became mm_counters with special access macros.  And it would no
longer be viable if we're relying on page_table_lock to stabilize the
mm_counter
column2: but calling tlb_finish_mmu outside that lock.

column1: Remove the mmu_gather's freed field
column2: let tlb_finish_mmu stick to its own

column1: business
column2: just decrement the rss mm_counter in zap_pte_range (yes

column1: some point to batching the update
column2: and a subsequent patch restores that).  And

column1: forget the anal paranoia of first reading the counter to avoid going negative
- if rss does go negative
Remove the mmu_gather's flushes and avoided_flushes from arm and arm26: no use
was being made of them.  But arm26 alone was actually using the freed
way some others use need_flush: give it a need_flush.  arm26 seems to prefer
spaces to tabs here: respect that.
